title: Measures on Cameron's treelike classes and applications to tensor categories
summary: Measures on Fraïssé classes are a key input in the Harman--Snowden (2022) construction of tensor categories. Treelike Fraïssé classes provide a particularly tractable source of examples. In this paper, we complete the classification of measures on Cameron's elementary treelike classes. In particular, for the class $\partial \mathfrak{T}_3(n)$ of node-colored rooted binary tree structures with $n$ colors, we classify measures by an explicit bijection with directed rooted trees edge-labeled by $\{1, \dots, n\}$ with a distinguished vertex, yielding $(2n+2)^n$ distinct…
